t: This LAP 2G switched socket provides a reliable 13A power source with integrated dual USB charging ports. Ideal for modern kitchens, offices and living spaces, this unit is highly suited for electricians installing premium fixtures. The premium satin brass finish with black inserts offers a stylish, modern look. The built-in USB Type-A and USB Type-C ports deliver a shared 12W output to charge smartphones and tablets without bulky adaptors. Colour-coded terminals with captive screws ensure a quick and straightforward installation.
